results.title: Tank roads, entry routes to remain closed under Section 144 Peshawar
results.description: PESHAWAR - The district administration of Tank has imposed Section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and ordered the closure of major and minor roads to traffic on Monday in view of the prevailing law and order situation.
